text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I am quite surprised. Trainer-san, you 
are quite skilled at crane games, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What kind of training is that supposed to 
be, and from what era?! ...Honestly.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm honestly really happy you 
caught so many for me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No, it's proof that you took me
seriously, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
So I'll be taking care of every single
one 
of these little guys.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"If I asked Believe-san,
I wonder if she'd 
make me a nice shelf...?"
